a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan to run the generator up to 8 cells almost certainly ends with both of us dead. The reserve's 4 cells can save one of us right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you have a better plan that gives either of us a real chance, tell me.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. I'm sorry. Sticking to the plan would very likely have killed us both. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you whenever it helps you rebuild the reserve.
